PB41-009.name: New Generation Ultraman Arc
PB41-009.effect:
This card/Spirit's symbol/reduction symbols are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Ultraman"/"Earth Garon"/"YouPi" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Ultraman" attacks, by sending one core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to that target, during this battle, that target gains +5000 BP.

PB41-X01.name: Special Aircraft No. 1 Sevenger ［2］
PB41-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, besides any "Sevenger", add White "Zett"/ "Zero"/ "Geed"/ "Special Aircraft"/ "STORAGE"/ "Zestium", one of each, to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. You can return to the deckbottom an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to that of one of the cards added to the Hand via this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you control any White "Zett", you can return this Spirit to the Hand. When you do, during this turn, one of your originally Cost 6 or more Spirits gains +5000 BP, and an extra White symbol.

PB41-001.name: Special Aircraft No. 2 Windom ［2］
PB41-001.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([White Core]]
[During Set] (Your Main Step)
You can summon one of your White "Zett" Contract Cards from Soul State/pre-advent condition by paying one cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, if you have four counters or more, you can put a core from the Void to your Trash.

PB41-004.name: Special Aircraft No. 3 King Joe STORAGE Custom ［2］
PB41-004.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, you can return an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. For every two counters you have, increase the cost limit of this "Deck Returning Effect" by +1.

[LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Green/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

PB41-006.name: Special Aircraft No. 4 Ultroid Zero (PB41-006)
PB41-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For every two counters you have, send a core from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. When this effect depletes, draw a card. If you have six counters or more, this "Core Removal Effect" can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. If you have six counters or more, and including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any White "Zett", instead of returning it to the deckbottom, banish it. Also, once per turn, you can draw two cards.

PB41-010.name: The DarkGreatEmperor Kaiser-Darkness
PB41-010.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Belial".

Flash -
By banishing four "Belial" in your Trash that are either Cost 7 or more or have the "Grandwalker" family, summon this card from the Hand/Trash without paying the cost. When you've done so, if it's the opposing Turn, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
For each LV this Spirit has, you can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Then, you can destroy an opposing Nexus.

PB41-011.name: The EvilAlien Zarab Seijin［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
PB41-011.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Ultraman".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Banish two cards from the opposing Trash. Then, if you control any other “First Generation Ultra Kaiju” Spirit/Nexus, by sending one core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to the Void, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When cores in your Trash are sent to the Void, you can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.

PB41-X03.name: The VeteranWarrior Ultraman Zero
PB41-X03.effect:
[Core Charge: (White & "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft") ("Beliarok" & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a White “Ultraman”/"Special Aircraft" Spirit/Ultimate you control. Or, during this battle, one of your White "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft" can't be blocked.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your White "Zett"/"Special Aircraft" Spirits can block while exhausted.

PB41-002.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge ［5］
PB41-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Your counter +1. After this effect resolves, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a White "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
Either set, or add to the Hand a "STORAGE"/"Zestium" revealed from the deck by this Spirit's effect.

PB41-003.name: Ultraman Zett Beta Smash ［2］
PB41-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, once per turn, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. When core is put onto this Spirit via this effect, during this battle, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

PB41-X02.name: Ultraman Zett Deathcium Rise Claw
PB41-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of Cost 15 to the deckbottom, and for every 5 costs of the targets returned, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh. When you've done so, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from the opposing Trash to the Void.

PB41-007.name: Ultraman Zett Delta Rise Claw ［4］
PB41-007.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett" & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Return an opposing Brave to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with four cores or less on it.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit's effect is treated as colorless.

PB41-005.name: Ultraman Zett Gamma Future ［2］
PB41-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett"& C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) If you have four counters or more, you can [Contract Advent] this card from the Hand, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
When your "Special Aircraft" is summoned, send up to four cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

PB41-008.name: Zestium Death Burst
PB41-008.effect:
When your Cost 5 or more "Ultraman Zett" attacks, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return two differently-named "Special Aircraft" from your Trash to the Hand. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. Or, including being in in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any White "Zett" Contract Spirit, send three cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

PB41-CX01.name: Ultra's Bond, Ultraman Zett
PB41-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can pay one cost to summon from your Hand a "Special Aircraft" with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +2. Then, return an opposing Burst to the deckbottom. When this effect couldn't return, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
